title: Top 5 BIGGEST Black Holes In The Universe
hook: Number one may tip the scales at up to 100 billion suns, making it possibly the largest black hole ever found.

items.name: Sagittarius A*
items.stat: Our galaxy's central black hole packs about 4.3 million times the Sun's mass into a region smaller than Mercury's orbit.

items.name: M87*
items.stat: The first black hole ever photographed weighs about 6.5 billion Suns and spans a shadow larger than our entire solar system.
items.query: M87 black hole Event Horizon Telescope

items.name: NGC 4889
items.stat: This monster tips the scales at roughly 21 billion solar masses, with an event horizon far wider than Pluto's orbit.

items.name: TON 618
items.stat: This ultramassive quasar black hole holds an estimated 40 to 66 billion times the mass of the Sun.

items.name: Phoenix A
items.stat: Estimated at up to 100 billion solar masses, it may be the largest black hole ever detected.
